note: Append-only execution evidence. Case definitions stay frozen and their runs arrays stay empty; every record here references a case id, the implementation revision it was observed against, and an evidence artifact. A record is never edited in place: a re-run appends. Nothing in this file is a substitute for the case's pass criterion. A copy of a record is not additional evidence; a deleted record is a change.
rules: caseId must exist in the referenced dataset version
datasetVersion must equal the referenced dataset version
implementationRevision must be a full 40-character revision
date must be a real calendar date
evidence must be a path under artifacts/ with no traversal
runId must be unique; the store is append-only, so removing a record is a reportable change
outcome is a semantic result (passed/failed/refused/blocked), separate from whether the host ran at all
